99: Gemara. Heifer - which is within its [first] year, and if the year has past, it is disqualified, because everywhere in the Torah where it says "heifer" without further qualification, it must be [no more than] one year old. This is derived from "a calf and a lamb, yearlings" [Leviticus 9:3].
Red heifer - it has no set age.
A  blemish disqualifies it - as is written regarding the red heifer, "in which there is no defect" [Numbers 19:2].
